description: Annual formation is a dataset listed in SBB open data platform, an open data platform of a railway operator, published or maintained by SBB (Swiss Federal Railways). Die Formation ist die Zusammenstellung von Fahrzeugtypen zu einem Zug der SBB. Die Formation sagt nicht aus in welcher Richtung die Wagen aufgereiht sind (ob die Lokomotive an der Zugspitze oder am Zugsende aufgereiht ist). Die Jahresformation ist die Zusammenstellung aller Formationen für eine Fahrplanperiode und wird mit dem Kursbuch veröffentlicht. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Traffic, Rolling stock. The portal shows 2026-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://data.sbb.ch/page/licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sbb-open-data-portal.
